description: This is a C# class implementing a decorator pattern for ICatalogItemService, adding caching functionality using local storage for catalog items in a Blazor web application.

classes.name: CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator implementing ICatalogItemService that caches catalog items in local storage to improve performance and reduce server calls.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, using cache if valid.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves the full list of catalog items, using cache if valid.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Fetches a specific catalog item by ID from the cached list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item and refreshes local storage cache.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item and updates the cache.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID and refreshes the cache.

methods.name: RefreshLocalStorageList
methods.description: Clears and refreshes the cached list of catalog items in local storage.
